Mia - CSM: quick heads-up — Pat from Aviatrix flagged 98th pct tail latency spikes during peak onboarding flows. thinking a small config + model mix could get them below their renewal risk threshold :eyes:
Omar (PerfEng): dug into traces, most spikes are at >1k tokens with long prefix repetition. KV cache hits are low. 2 quick levers: 1) try compact-int8 for chat endpoints 2) add prefix-preserve caching for the onboarding prompt set. both low-risk canaryable changes.
Pat - Aviatrix: thanks — our users hit that long prompt when importing docs. what impact on quality? we can tolerate minor hallucination shifts but not >3% rouge drop.
Jen (Solutions): recommended playbook: 1) create a canary route (route: aviatrix-compact-canary) 2) deploy compact-int8 model variant with fallback to standard fp16 3) enable prefix cache with TTL=1h for import templates 4) limit batch size to 8 for p99 latency SLOs.
Omar (PerfEng): expected perf delta: token cost ~0.6x, p95 latency down ~25%, p99 down ~15% in our sim. quality: expect <2% metric delta on our eval suite (we should run their golden prompts).
Alex - AE: renewal note — Aviatrix is flagged yellow; if we show 20% cost saving and stable UX this month we should be able to keep them on annual. Mia, can we own a short exec summary for renewal?
Mia - CSM: yes — I'll draft a one-pager. Omar/Jen: can you produce a concise playback (metrics + config) we can share?
Omar (PerfEng): putting numbers together now. snippet for canary config below — can test in 15 mins: ```json
{
  "route": "aviatrix-compact-canary",
  "model": "gpt-4o-compact-int8",
  "fallback": "gpt-4o-fp16",
  "cache": {"type":"prefix","ttl":"3600s","max_entries":2000},
  "batching": {"max_batch_tokens":4096,"max_concurrent":8}
}
```
Jen (Solutions): rollout plan: 5% traffic -> monitor tokens/latency/errors for 2 hours -> 25% if stable -> 100% with automatic fallback to fp16 on error rate spike >0.5%. Add eval hook: run their golden 120 prompts on canary every 30m and surface rouge/EM.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment aviatrix-compact-canary started by Omar at 1759000015 :rocket:
Pat - Aviatrix: can we toggle cache TTL per-environment? import flows differ dev vs prod.
Jen (Solutions): yes — TTL is per-route. we'll add dev TTL=600s and prod TTL=3600s. we'll also add a toggle for aggressive-kv-eviction to avoid stale context.
Omar (PerfEng): one more idea: smart routing policy to route short queries to fp16 (higher quality) and long doc imports to compact-int8. config example: `routing.rule = if tokens>256 then compact_int8 else fp16`. That keeps UX high while saving cost.
Alex - AE: sounds like a strong commercial story. Mia — request a short customer quote after we hit canary metrics?
Mia - CSM: yes — I'll request feedback during the 25% window. Pat — would love a quick note if you see any regressions. :pray:
Pat - Aviatrix: will do. appreciate the fast loop. schedule a 30-min sync after 25% rollout?
Mia - CSM: scheduled — Mia/Pat/Omar/Jen on a call at 1759000050. I'll drop the calendar invite and one-pager beforehand.
Omar (PerfEng): logging action items: run golden prompts against compact-int8 canary, push metric dashboard (p50/p95/p99, cost per 1k tokens, rouge diff), implement routing rule. will post results in this thread.
Mia - CSM: thanks team — goal: reduce p99 by 20% and cost by ~30% while keeping quality delta <3%.
